exact_claim: At any smooth fixed-reference Q wall equilibrium on a fixed finite interval with positive density and gradient, fixed positive physical coefficients, fixed mass and both field endpoints, and bounded coercive full Q0 on H1_0 triples, there is a unique nearby C1 branch of local equilibria as lambda varies with the SAME constraints. The normalized hydrostatic density elimination gives a C1 H2-Dirichlet-to-L2 nonlinear map; its reduced derivative is the fluid-minimized full form, coercive and an H2 isomorphism. On the branch u_lambda=−z, where a0(z,v)=ell[v], ell=−integral(q psi prime+T_chi eta)/C. Hence R prime=integral T_chi/C+beta with beta=Q0[z]>=0. At an actual global equilibrium intersection V prime=R the FGF033 margin equals V second derivative−R prime. An old fixed-left-IVP derivative generally changes mass and right walls and is not this response.

The exact full fixed-mass Q0 is bounded and coercive on H1_0 triples after fixed positive unit scaling; mere strict positivity is insufficient.
Use an H2 Dirichlet field neighborhood, smooth constitutive functions away from g=0, and original isothermal hydrostatic fluid closure; no scalar V is chosen or fitted.
For interpreting V second derivative−R prime as the full dynamical margin, additionally assume a real intersection of one independently supplied V and positive inherited/global kinetic coefficients.
